newsitem.title: USA: CNA Financial to form new business unit.
newsitem.headline: CNA Financial to form new business unit.

text.p: CNA Financial Corp said Wednesday it will form a new company that will develop opportunities for the securitization of insurance risks.
CNA said the new entity, called Hedge Financial Products Inc, will tap into what the company called "the evolving links between financial markets and risk transfer."
Richard Sandor will serve as chairman and chief executive officer of the new unit.
CNA FInancial is an insurance holding company with revenues of $16.7 billion for the 12 months ended September 30.
Its shares closed off 1-1/8 Wednesday at 103-1/8.
